newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank backs ABN AMRO on Thai bid.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank backs ABN AMRO on Thai bid.

text.p: Senior executives of Bangkok Bank Plc on Monday gave their support for ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Asia (Holdings) Ltd 's tender offer to acquire 49 percent of stakes of Thai broker Asia Securities Trading Plc.

"ABN AMRO HG Asia's offer represents the best way for our two companies to continue the strong partnership we have held for the past six years. Our companies are compatible and I believe will continue to be successful by working together," a statement quoted Chali Sophonpanich, chief executive officer and chairman of Asia Securities Trading, as saying.
ABN AMRO announced earlier this month a 35 baht per share offer for a 49 percent stake of the Thai broker which it said the purchase would cost some 2.2 billion baht.
Bangkok Bank, Thailand's largest commercial bank, is a major shareholder in Asia Securities Trading with a 9.1 percent stake.
